scope: Content, editorial, help and policy pages for the WOW Fashion website preview
interpretation: Existing public material is evidence of what the previous website published, not approval of future business terms. New operational claims require current business confirmation.

sourceReview.retrieval: Search-service cached primary page; direct request returned HTTP 403
sourceReview.finding: The retrieved contact page exposed an unresolved form shortcode. No usable support email, postal address or response commitment was verified.
sourceReview.implementation: Contact prepares a local text draft, provides copy/edit actions and links to the existing contact page as a handoff. It does not submit an enquiry or invent a contact address.

sourceReview.retrieval: Search-service cached primary page; direct request returned HTTP 403
sourceReview.finding: Historical return, warranty and refund wording exists but the operating model and current supplier commitments for the rebuilt shop are unconfirmed.
sourceReview.implementation: Historical deadlines, free-return claims, return addresses and warranty promises were not carried into the rebuilt pages. The pages explain how to prepare a request and clearly identify policy review requirements.

sourceReview.retrieval: Search-service cached primary page; direct request returned HTTP 403
sourceReview.finding: Historical delivery fees and estimates are published. Their applicability to the rebuilt shop has not been established.
sourceReview.implementation: No delivery fee, minimum spend, destination commitment or arrival-time promise was invented or migrated. The page guides visitors to check destination, dispatch and delivery details before a real purchase.

sourceReview.retrieval: Search-service cached primary page; direct and open requests returned HTTP 403
sourceReview.finding: The original guide describes size differences between suppliers and advises checking the chart for the specific product.
sourceReview.implementation: The size guide provides measuring notes and a real centimetre/inch converter, while making clear that the item-specific chart determines size. No universal body-to-size chart is asserted.

sourceReview.retrieval: Search-service cached primary page; direct request returned HTTP 403
sourceReview.finding: The retrieved historical policy includes an unresolved payment-method placeholder and an obfuscated contact address. It cannot establish the new operator, providers or processing practices.
sourceReview.implementation: The privacy page describes the implemented preview only, documents actual local/session storage, and identifies the legal identity, contact, processor, retention and deployment review still required.

sourceReview.retrieval: Search-service cached primary page; direct request returned HTTP 403
sourceReview.finding: Historical team and experience statements were found but were not established as current business facts for this build.
sourceReview.implementation: About uses collection positioning without a founder story, team count, trading history, qualifications or testing claims. The author page transparently identifies a house editorial byline.

sourceReview.finding: Primary destination for existing catalogue listings and the current shop.
sourceReview.implementation: Existing-shop links are general handoffs. The rebuilt preview does not claim to access existing accounts, orders or payments.

localEvidence.purpose: Authoritative requested core-page inventory, routes, purposes and pre-launch requirements.

Proposed standards for separating styling preferences from product facts, avoiding unsupported testing and sourcing claims, and confirming commercial disclosures. These are not treated as already approved business policies.
Generated campaign source descriptions and image purpose. Campaign imagery is identified as illustrative styling rather than product evidence.
Existing evening campaign route, asset and description reused by the original day-to-evening journal guide.
Reviewed sample session-storage keys and data structures. No personal, address, password or card data is persisted by these demo records.
Shared wishlist key and event contract. Clearing saved pieces dispatches wow:request-saved with detail.clear=true.
Actual client behaviour: no external API requests; local enquiry preparation, in-memory measuring notes, exact preference/storage controls and no installed optional tracker.
Migration bridge for the two preserved dress-page wishlists; legacy keys can remain before migration or after storage/catalogue failure.
